purpose: Authenticated saved-original metadata discovery for a new registration; not local original binding, formal rendition, current filesystem existence, confirmation or ACK proof

query.cursor: optional ASCII opaque canonical cursor, max640; absent for first page

items.capture_id: nonblank opaque UTF8, byte/case/whitespace preservation; max2048UTF8 for this bounded inventory only

server_pagination: Exact immutable session UUID order; cursor canonical unpadded base64url JSON bound to version/current destination/registration/generation/limit/last session; reject aliases and missing boundary. Same-cursor retry remains a read.
server_eligibility: same destination, completed binding and exact valid saved evidence/asset/job/claim. Incomplete uploads absent; corrupted completed/evidence or oversized identity/page rejects whole page. No media FD/publication authority.
client_rules: one explicit action fetches one page; explicit continuation
validate current connection/registration/storeUUID before and after awaits/commit
journal page observation through same writer; store exact request/current registration/response and cursor
remote-only projection remains separate from local RecordingStoreEntry; no bind or local reference fabrication
preserve same-capture different-content conflicts and no automatic matching
empty/missing page never removes prior local or observed records
no media request, automatic download, old confirmation restoration or old ACK substitution
acceptance: non-device partial S28 only; remote producer/store/UI integration and tests pending
